name: sutra
description: A senior-engineer operating system for Claude Code -- architecture review, verification discipline, multi-session build orchestration, doc sanitization, and commit craft, delivered as skills, subagents, and layered lite/standard/strict profiles.

profile.title: Sutra profile
profile.description: lite, standard, strict, or off. Empty means standard, which a repository's .sutra file may raise to strict. The SUTRA_PROFILE environment variable overrides this setting.
